# 00000004309

**AN4-09 ★** — source: 129_数论IV_代数数论显式方法.md

**English.** Definition: The Stickelberger element is the ideal-valued invariant of the cyclotomic field generated by discriminant sums. Conjecture: The order of the quotient of its image in the class group is exactly the odd part of the class number, and the quotient table is completely explicit for conductors at most 100. (Stickelberger quotient odd-part identity)

**中文。** 定义：Stickelberger 元指分圆域中由判别式和生成的理想法向。猜想：其在类群中像的商群阶恰为类数的奇部分,商表在导子不超过 100 时完全显式。（Stickelberger 商奇部恒等）
